instruction: A candid lifestyle photograph, full shot at eye-level, captures a modern indoor living room with a dark grey sofa and potted plants. On the left, the woman in the cream and black dress (R2) sits on the sofa with crossed legs, smiling warmly. On the right, the woman in the light blue t-shirt and beige pants (R1) sits on the floor, leaning against the sofa and smiling back. They extend their arms to clink their glass bottles together in a friendly toast. Bright, natural light streams from the large window behind them, casting soft shadows across the neutral-toned room.
